title: Provisions and the Exchange Rate Turned a Profit Into a Record Loss
subtitle: The State Transport Leasing Company, owned by the state through VEB.RF, set aside 20 billion rubles in reserves and lost 23 billion on currency conversion.

source.name: State Transport Leasing Company first-half 2026 results reported by Kommersant

supportingFacts.label: The company is held by the Russian state through VEB.RF, so the loss lands on a public balance sheet.
Combined weight of provisions and currency losses, three times the size of the headline loss itself.

metadata.keyFinding: A record 14.2 billion ruble loss followed 43 billion rubles of provisions and currency losses.
